players.bio: Alireza Jahanbakhsh (born 11 August 1993) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Belgian Pro League club FCV Dender EH and captains the Iran national team. In 2014 Jahanbakhsh was voted the second greatest young talent of the 2013–14 Eredivisie season.

Calvin Owen Harm Raatsie (born 9 February 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club Excelsior. A youth academy graduate of Ajax, Raatsie made his professional debut for club's reserve side Jong Ajax on 15 February 2021 in a 1–2 defeat against Dordrecht.

Casper Ludvig Widell (born 5 May 2003) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eredivisie club Excelsior and the Sweden under-21 national team. Club career Born in Landskrona, in the Swedish province of Scania, Widell started playing football as a child in the local club IK Wormo, together with his brother Melker (who later joined the youth sector of Malmö FF).

Yoon Do-young (born 28 October 2006) is a South Korean professional footballer who plays as a winger for Eredivisie Club Excelsior, on loan from Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion. He made his debut professional appearance in the 2024 K League 1 season with Daejeon Hana Citizen.
Eric Emanuel da Silva Moreira is a German professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Primeira Liga club Rio Ave, on loan from Premier League club Nottingham Forest.

Irakli Yegoian is a Georgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Excelsior. Early life Yegoian was born on 19 March 2004 in Tbilisi, Georgia. Of Armenian descent through his parents, he moved with his family to the Netherlands at a young age.
Jan Plug (born 2 April 2005) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eerste Divisie club Dordrecht, on loan from Eredivisie club Feyenoord.
Kasey Bos (born 8 May 2004) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a left back for German Bundesliga club Mainz 05.
Lennard Hartjes (born 7 April 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Dutch Eredivisie club Excelsior, on loan from Feyenoord.

Mario Domínguez Franco (born 10 February 2004), sometimes known as just Domi, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Spanish club Valencia. A youth product of Granada, Domínguez moved to the youth academy of Valencia in 2019.
Mathijs Dimphinus Wilhelmus Tielemans is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Eredivisie club Excelsior.
Mike van Duinen ( born 6 November 1991) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club Excelsior.

Noah Naujoks (born 2 May 2002) is a Dutch footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Excelsior Rotterdam. Career Feyenoord Naujoks joined the Feyenoord academy in 2010 and came through their system able to play a variety of positions in midfield, but prefers to play in an attacking number 10 role.

Nolan Martens is a 21-year-old Belgian professional footballer who plays as a defender (primarily right-back) for the Dutch Eredivisie club Excelsior Rotterdam and the Belgium U21 national team. He joined Excelsior in January 2025 from KRC Genk.

Rick Meissen (born 24 February 2002) is a Dutch footballer who plays for as a central defender for Eredivisie club Excelsior Rotterdam. Career Meissen moved from AVV Zeeburgia to FC Utrecht in the summer of 2016. On 25 February 2020 he signed his first professional contract with Utrecht signing until the summer of 2023, with the option of an extra year.

Ruben den Uil (born 3 February 1991) is a Dutch professional football manager who manages Eredivisie club Excelsior. After Excelsior's relegation from the Eredivisie at the end of the 2023–24 season, the club parted ways with head coach Marinus Dijkhuizen. On 28 June 2024, Den Uil was promoted to head coach, becoming the youngest manager in Dutch professional football at the time.
Simon Janssen (born 25 September 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left-back.

Stan Henderikx (born 8 July 2003 in Asten) is a Dutch footballer who plays as a defender. In the summer of 2025, he exchanged FC Den Bosch for Excelsior Rotterdam. Career Henderikx was scouted at NWC in 2012 by Helmond Sport and switched to the youth academy of VVV-Venlo four years later.
Stijn van Gassel (born 17 October 1996) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club Excelsior.

Valentin Sulzbacher is a 21-year-old Austrian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for the Dutch Eredivisie club Excelsior Rotterdam. Carreer He started his career with FC Altmünster und ASKÖ Ohlsdorf. 2015 he went on to the FC Red Bull Salzburg Academy. In the 2021-22 season he played his first match for FC Liefering.
